gen-gf-baumans-fs-synonym: Baumans has a crescent-wrench c, wide open, and every stroke in it is drawn at a single thickness. Synonym sits beside it as a quiet sans-serif, dependable and unfussy.
gen-gf-baumans-outfit: Commanding in presence, Baumans draws every stroke at one thickness, and Outfit follows with curves that stop short of closing. They share a bent-cable simplicity.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-amulya: Skimming, stylus-drawn lines with ends that hang off the spine. Bellota is the one to catch the eye with its unchanging stroke, while Amulya quietly keeps its curves generous and modern.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-chillax: Chillax reads loose, like spaghetti spelled out in letters. Bellota is best at grabbing attention with its far-hanging s ends and stylus-width strokes, while Chillax is best at relaxing into casual, unfinished loops.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-plein: Wire-thin strokes with a hanging s. Bellota is best at standing out with that drawn-wire thickness, whereas Plein is best at being reliable, with a clear channel leading into each round letter.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans is a contemporary, approachable sans-serif with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. And Bellota, with its far-hanging s and stylus-width strokes, gives that openness something distinctive to stand under.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-synonym: Bellota's s hangs its ends far from the spine. Synonym, a sans-serif made of constant ink with generous curves, sits underneath and lets that distinctive heading do the talking.
gen-gf-bellota-outfit: Stylus-traced strokes with an s that lets its ends drift away. Outfit, a sans-serif of curves that stop short of closing, follows Bellota's commanding look with an approachable calm, and Bellota does its best work big and short.
gen-gf-bellota-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads geometric and neutral, with counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open. And Bellota earns its keep big and short, its s ends hanging far from the spine.
